en.description:
Forty-two games for Apple Watch. Cards, board games, puzzles, arcade action and a few things that just look good on your wrist — all of them built for a small screen and a spare minute.

Nothing here needs the internet. No accounts, no ads, no purchases, and nothing leaves your watch. Open a game and play.

THE GAMES

Cards — Aces Up, Crazy Eights, Cribbage, Go Fish, Pyramid
Board — Backgammon, Checkers, Dominoes, Dots & Boxes, Four in a Row, Reversi, Salvo, Yacht
Puzzle — 2048, Blackout, Bulls & Cows, Crates, Mines, Peg Solitaire, Sliding, Sudoku
Action — Blocks, Bricks, Chomp, Glide, Hopper, Pinball, Runner, Snake
Aim — 9-Ball, Bowling, Darts, Dogfight, Drift, Flick, Golf, Tilt Maze
Eye Candy — Automata, Fractal, Langton's Ant, Life, Pendulum

BUILT FOR THE WATCH, NOT SHRUNK TO FIT

Tap and drag do most of it. Eleven games take the Digital Crown, where it is the better control — aiming a cue, putting spin on a bowling ball, changing the speed of a simulation — and two are steered by leaning your wrist.

EVERY GAME EXPLAINS ITSELF

How to Play sits in every game's menu: what winning means, and which control the game is actually listening for. No game leaves you guessing.

IT REMEMBERS WHERE YOU WERE

A dropped wrist or a notification does not cost you a game. The long ones keep their position — the sudoku grid, the cribbage hand, the crate you were pushing — and hand it back when you return.

IT KEEPS SCORE

Best scores where a score makes sense, fewest moves where that is the better measure, and a win-loss record against Otto, the opponent in ten of the games.
en.releaseNotes:
Darts is easier to throw, and easier to see.

• Tap anywhere on the screen to throw. The throw button is gone — where you tap has never mattered, only when.
• The dartboard now fills the screen instead of sitting in a strip down the middle of it, with the score and your called target moved into the corners.
en.subtitle: 42 games for your wrist

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Your game waits for you now.

• Chomp, Hopper, Blocks, Bricks, Pinball, Dogfight, Flick and Drift keep your run when you leave. Come back and it's where you left it, held still until you tap.
• Games no longer play on quietly while the screen is dimmed — they pause, and pick up when you look back.
• Tilt Maze remembers the level you reached.
• Clearing Mines now flags the mines you avoided, so a win looks like a win.

Darts is easier to throw, and easier to see.

• Tap anywhere on the screen to throw. The throw button is gone — where you tap has never mattered, only when.
• The dartboard now fills the screen instead of sitting in a strip down the middle of it, with the score and your called target moved into the corners.
